# Jessica Johnson

# Board Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/JessicaJohnsonBoardMemberAL9-square-enhanced.png)

- In a [candidate questionaire](https://civicatlanta.org/voteatl/candidate/2023-jessica-johnson)[](https://web.archive.org/web/20260728113445/https:/civicatlanta.org/voteatl/candidate/2023-jessica-johnson), when asked about a policy or procedure that was not working well and that she would want to change, Johnson identified the fact that it was “currently not a requirement” to use “data to determine biased discipline practices against students of color.”
- Johnson [](https://web.archive.org/web/20260728113445/https:/civicatlanta.org/voteatl/candidate/2023-jessica-johnson) a policy change that was a step in the right direction was “Our policy for Critical Race Theory, which allowed flexibility for schools to determine the appropriate curriculum content to share with their students, was definitely a step in the right direction. The language of the policy, along with the bold statement from the Board which outlined its commitment to maintaining the importance of diversity in education, empowered our teachers to truly lead their classrooms.”
